audit.whatIsWrong: Every row disagreed with the page's own whys. Stored chart was Riven / Skill x5 / Riven; the whys read even / Riven / Riven / you / you / Riven / you, which is the packet chart exactly.
audit.why: Riven has two windows — levels 2-3 and her first item — and Urgot takes 4-5, level 6 and the late game at a 55.68% win rate. The run of Skill rows erased both swings.
audit.corrected: All seven rows proposed as matched full/content pairs to the packet shape, with ratings aligned and phases[1].why, phases[2].why and phases[5].why rewritten because they described Urgot winning rows that now read Riven. The mirror had already flipped row 0 to Skill and row 6 to Urgot, so those two agree with it.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text says to 'Purge her low and R to flip the fight'.
audit.why: Fear Beyond Death impales and executes; Disdain (E) is the flip. It also misses the level-6 fact that actually matters against Riven: Blade of the Exile (R, 120s at rank 1) grants her Wind Slash, and per the mirror that ranged attack scales with the target's MISSING health. Sitting low in her R range is exactly what kills you.
audit.corrected: Impale and execute, and stay above the Wind Slash breakpoint rather than lingering at low health near her ult.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere, and breakdown.cooldowns listed Ki Burst twice.
audit.why: The whole lane is her three short cooldowns against Purge's 490 range: Broken Wings (Q) is 13s and covers all three casts with the third knocking back — that knockback is what breaks Urgot out of a point-blank Purge; Ki Burst (W) is 11s at rank 1 to 7s; Valor (E) is 10s to 6s and gives both a dash and a damage block. Her E is the burst-absorber to bait, her Q is the mobility to wait out.
audit.corrected: All three cooldowns written in, with the commit keyed to Broken Wings and Valor being spent rather than to the stun alone.

audit.why: Nothing in the brief indicates a recent change to either kit on 26.15.

edits.before: E or W second depending on kill pressure. A landed E-flip into W spray already wins most level-2 exchanges outright.
edits.after: Ki Burst (W), 11s at rank 1, plus the Valor shield gives her level-2 trade tempo before you even have Disdain.

edits.before: Full legs rotation online — this is your lane now. Walk Riven down with W whenever Ki Burst (Stun) is on cooldown.
edits.after: Her peak: full Broken Wings into Ki Burst bursts you before Purge finishes. Give ground until the dashes are gone.

edits.before: Black Cleaver stacks instantly with W — your shred turns even tanky answers soft. Shove and force Riven to trade into the spike.
edits.after: Her first item makes the combo lethal again. Do not trade into a fresh Broken Wings; wait for the three casts to be spent.

edits.before: Riven's power spike: her full Q (Broken Wings) three-hit, E (Valor) shield, and W stun let her burst you before you can W-shred. Bait her Q dashes and E shield out, then Q (Corrosive Charge) and W her once her mobility is spent.
edits.after: Riven's power spike: Broken Wings (Q, 13s) three-hits and knocks back on the third, Valor (E, 10s) dashes and shields, Ki Burst (W, 11s) stuns. Bait the E shield, then Corrosive Charge and Purge once her dashes are spent.

edits.before: Your R (Fear Beyond Death) beats her all-in. She has no execute, so if she W-stuns and combos you, Purge her low and R to flip the fight.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death (R) beats her all-in: if she Ki Bursts in, Purge her, then impale and execute. Her Wind Slash grows with your missing health.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 favour Riven. Her Broken Wings mobility, E shield and W stun let her burst you before your slow kit answers; bait her dashes, only commit once her mobility is on cooldown, and survive to R.
edits.after: Levels 2-3 and her first item favour Riven. Broken Wings (13s), Valor's shield (10s) and Ki Burst (11s) burst you before your kit answers — commit only once the dashes are spent, and survive to level 6.

edits.before: Punish the window after her mobility is spent
edits.after: Commit after Broken Wings and Valor are spent

edits.before: Use E (Valor) and Q dashes to dodge your Purge
edits.after: Dash out of Purge's 490 range with E and Q

edits.before: - Riven Ki Burst (Stun): matchup-defining — Her engage CC. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Riven Ki Burst: Short-range AoE stun — her engage CC. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Ki Burst (W), 11s at rank 1 to 7s: her engage stun, so commit after it. - Valor (E), 10s to 6s: a dash plus a shield, and Broken Wings (Q) is 13s for all three casts.

edits.before: Her engage CC. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Her engage stun, 11s at rank 1. Commit once it is spent.

notes: The packet's suspectName hit on 'Her Broken Wings' is a false positive — Broken Wings is the correct name for Riven's Q and the string uses it correctly. Encoding warning carried from the mirror: some full-layer strings in this matchup reportedly hold mojibake em dashes on disk. The brief's currentText renders them as clean em dashes, so I copied it verbatim; if any of my full-layer edits with an em dash in the before-string are rejected as stale, that is why, and the fix is a repo-wide encoding pass rather than a per-matchup retype. The three enum-only chart rows and the ASCII-clean strings are unaffected either way. Best new fact on the page: the third cast of Broken Wings knocks back, which is her tool for breaking out of a point-blank Purge — so the commit condition is her dashes being spent, not just her stun.
